svg.text: Input guardrail → supervisor → multi-agent LangGraph pipeline with human-in-the-loop approval, MCP servers as tools · branch multi-agent-supervisor-guardrails-hitl
trip text + start date · Approve / Request changes
END · message shown in the UI

external API or plain Python tool
LLM (purple pills = nodes that call it)
1. input_guardrail_agent runs first. A request that is not about planning a trip (or is harmful) goes to reply_agent with the reason and the run ends; it never reaches the supervisor.
2. supervisor_agent selects which specialists run (flight, hotel, weather, itinerary, budget). No destination, or only an information question (e.g. visa rules)? It goes to reply_agent instead.
3. After the last specialist, human_approval_agent pauses with interrupt(). Approve → final_agent. Request changes → itinerary_agent rewrites the draft, keeping every earlier change.
4. Pause and resume work because state is checkpointed in PostgreSQL per thread_id; POST /api/approve resumes the run with Command(resume=...).

uv + uvicorn locally, or the Dockerfile (pre-warms the AviationStack package) → Render · LangSmith tracing (optional) · config in .env (LLM_PROVIDER, TAVILY_API_KEY, SERPAPI_API_KEY, OPENWEATHER_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL)
